DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • They’re focusing on single-target damage or adds are active, and one of these applies:
  • Their Gargoyle is active with ≤22 seconds remaining (if using the Summon Gargoyle talent)
  • They’re using Army of the Dead and their Abomination (with Raise Abomination talent) has <18 seconds remaining, or Army Ghouls have ≤18 seconds remaining
  • They have Dark Transformation active (if not using Gargoyle/Army of the Dead talents)
  • The enemy can’t summon a new Gargoyle soon (if theirs died early)
  • There are ≥3 enemies and Dark Transformation is active or Death and Decay is active
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • They are in Voidform and Power Infusion is not active.
  • Dark Ascension is active and Power Infusion is not active.
  • They have the TWW 2-piece set bonus and Power Infusion is not active.
